continuity: Won Myunghoon leaves the Mutated Gate after Taekyung orders him and the Star Guild away.
Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Im Kkeokjeong, and Song Song remain with Taekyung; Butler Kim creates layered magical barriers while Taekyung fights alone.
Song Song rejects Taekyung's confession but accepts a same-age friendship and guildmate relationship; they agree to drink soju after the battle.

The Black Wyvern from the Sangdong Station Mutated Gate incident returns as a Named Monster, now more than fifty meters long and at least two or three times larger than three years earlier, with one cloudy eye.
Taekyung remembers the comrades killed in the earlier incident, including Kim Hyunsu and Hong Cheonsu, and resolves to end his grudge with the Black Wyvern.
Taekyung's Scorching Yang Qi has surpassed one jiazi, and his accumulated rage transforms with his internal energy into blue-burning Aura and Spear Energy.
plot: After Won Myunghoon leaves, Jin Taekyung confirms that the approaching Named Monster is the Black Wyvern from the incident three years earlier and chooses to face it alone. Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Im Kkeokjeong, and Song Song remain behind; Butler Kim layers magical barriers to protect them. Song Song rejects Taekyung's confession, saying she will not change her attitude for money or fame, but accepts treating him as a same-age friend and guildmate, and they agree to drink soju after the fight. The Black Wyvern arrives, having grown to more than fifty meters—at least two or three times its former size—with one cloudy eye. Taekyung recalls the comrades killed in the earlier incident, including Kim Hyunsu, Lee Hyerim, Song Donghyeok, Park Sangho, Kim Haneung, Park Gwanghyeon, and Hong Cheonsu. Hong Cheonsu had been a ten-year veteran who saved Taekyung from goblins and was called hyung; he died leaving behind a spouse and three children. Taekyung advances toward the Black Wyvern after three years and ninety-two days, channels more than one jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi and accumulated rage into his spear, and prepares to kill it with blue-burning Aura and Spear Energy.

active_continuity: One Step Back granted Taekyung two level-ups and 20 Bonus Points.
Taekyung opened his Conception and Governor Vessels after consuming three Scorching Yang Qi elixirs.
Taekyung is publicly recognized as Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple and heir to the Fire Gate Clan’s orthodox lineage.
Jin Mukyung remains secluded in the training hall and has not returned to Heaven’s Gate Temple.
The Jin Family received an invitation to the Star-Array Grand Banquet in Henan.
Seong Jinho is staying at Taekyung’s new family home after losing his housing deposit to Kim Jong-su.
Taekyung is an A-Rank Hunter and nationally famous as the Tollgate Hero after the tollgate rescue and KPS interview.
The Peace Guild House has extensive magical communication, observation, and alarm systems, and its website has begun recruiting members.
The media frenzy exposed Taekyung’s family’s personal information, leaving him burdened by the hero label.
Won Myunghoon is a thirty-nine-year-old A-rank Hunter, former ranker and celebrity entertainer, and CEO of the Star Guild in Incheon; a false transfer report was corrected.
Taekyung and Team Leader Choi cleared The Lycanthrope’s Black Forest after Taekyung killed its Silver-Mane Lycanthrope boss.
The joint Peace Guild-Star Guild raid was redirected from Manticore’s Jungle to The Black Wyvern’s Nest.
Won killed the Lv. 97 Green Wyvern alone, so Taekyung received no EXP; Won lent him Yeti’s Necklace to attract a stronger monster.
Taekyung killed forty-seven B-Rank Orc Warriors alone, and Im Kkeokjeong was among the survivors he had rescued during an earlier E-Rank Gate attack.
Won gave Yeti’s Necklace to Taekyung, and a Named Monster Wyvern killed six scouts inside the A-Rank Mutated Gate.
Mutated Gates can contain monsters far above the Gate’s expected Grade, and Named Monsters are true monstrosities beyond the A-Rank boundary.
Team Leader 1 was afflicted by Fear, abandoned his team, and returned alone from the Named Monster encounter.
The Named Monster is the same Black Wyvern Taekyung fought three years earlier at the Sangdong Station Mutated Gate; it has grown to more than fifty meters and one eye remains cloudy.
Taekyung ordered Won and the Star Guild to leave, while Choi, Butler Kim, Im Kkeokjeong, and Song Song remained; Taekyung prepared blue-burning Aura and Spear Energy for the fight.
Taekyung confessed to Song Song; she rejected him without changing for money or fame but accepted a same-age friendship and guildmate relationship, and they agreed to drink soju after the battle.
open_questions: What are the rewards for the Conception Vessel Opening Achievement and the rare Achievement earned after completing the Conception and Governor Vessels Quest?
Will Jin Mukyung return to Heaven’s Gate Temple before the appointed deadline?
What event does Jeok Cheongang believe may occur sooner than expected, and why must he endure for several more years?
What is the true condition of the absent Martial God?
Will Taekyung attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet, and what exactly was the answer that changed the three men’s expressions?
What are the Reward and Failure conditions of the Gate Suppression Quest?
How will the Gate near Hwang Cheol Soo’s tollgate ultimately be contained, and what further monsters may emerge?
How will Taekyung and the remaining raid members survive the Black Wyvern, and what caused its extraordinary growth and transformation into a Named Monster?
